description: The reading faculties the agent's writing arc concluded it LACKS (grounded against human cognitive models: BPL, associative agnosia, dyslexia) and is now BUILDING. Each holds WHAT it is + the agent's own shape verdict (HOW it is structured) + the dissociation that names it. Seeded as build-targets (is_held 0, status under_construction); the agent decides HOW by shape, the build implements it graph-native.

attrs.name: generative_program_faculty
attrs.definition: INFER a probabilistic generative PROGRAM (a hierarchical PARSE of the character into strokes/sub-strokes plus relations) that explains one example, then PREDICT / re-render it with deformation and compare to the observation. Build first piece: per-character PARSE INFERENCE (description-length-minimal parse, domains/canonical_parse.infer_parse) — marginalise over parse granularities, keep the most parsimonious explanation, vs a single global threshold.

attrs.name: semantics_meaning_faculty
attrs.definition: BIND the recognised form to its MEANING; ASSOCIATE and RECALL the stored concept the form denotes; an autoassociative attractor that COMPLETES form to concept. Build first piece: form->concept associative BINDING (domains/semantic_binding) — the recognised mark denotes a meaning concept; every instance of a character recalls the SAME concept; meaning can carry relations, not just a label.
